# pbrew uninstall — 卸载组件

# 准备数据源
mkdir $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions
mkdir $HOME/repo/skills/commit
cp $FIXTURES/repo/_index.json $HOME/repo/_index.json
cp $FIXTURES/repo/rules/git-conventions/.pbrew.json $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions/.pbrew.json
cp $FIXTURES/repo/rules/git-conventions/git-conventions.md $HOME/repo/rules/git-conventions/git-conventions.md
cp $FIXTURES/repo/skills/commit/.pbrew.json $HOME/repo/skills/commit/.pbrew.json
cp $FIXTURES/repo/skills/commit/SKILL.md $HOME/repo/skills/commit/SKILL.md

exec pbrew config set source $HOME/repo

# 先安装 Rule 和 Skill
exec pbrew install git-conventions --agent claude --scope user --force
exec pbrew install commit --agent claude --scope user --force

# 确认安装文件存在
exists $HOME/.claude/rules/git-conventions/git-conventions.md
exists $HOME/.claude/skills/commit/SKILL.md

# 卸载 Rule
exec pbrew uninstall git-conventions --agent claude --scope user
stdout 'uninstalled git-conventions'

# 验证文件已删除
! exists $HOME/.claude/rules/git-conventions/git-conventions.md

# 验证安装记录中不再包含该组件
exec cat $HOME/.claude/.pbrew/_config.json
! stdout 'git-conventions'

# 其他已安装组件不受影响
exists $HOME/.claude/skills/commit/SKILL.md

# 卸载 Skill
exec pbrew uninstall commit --agent claude --scope user
stdout 'uninstalled commit'
! exists $HOME/.claude/skills/commit/SKILL.md

# 再次卸载已不存在的组件应报错
! exec pbrew uninstall git-conventions --agent claude --scope user

# 缺少 --scope 应报错
! exec pbrew uninstall commit --agent claude

# 缺少 --agent 应报错
! exec pbrew uninstall commit --scope user
